cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Excuse me. Would you mind if I asked you some questions? We’re doing a survey on transport.

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: Yes, that’s OK.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: First of all, can I take your name?

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: Yes. It’s Sadie Jones.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Thanks very much. And could I have your date of birth – just the year will do, actually. Is that all right?

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: Yes, that’s fine. It’s 1991.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: So next your postcode, please.

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: It’s DW3Q 7YZ. Q1

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Great. Thanks. Is that in Wells?

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: No it’s actually in Harborne- Wells isn’t far from there, though.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: I really like that area. My grandmother lived there when I was a kid.

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: Yes, it is nice.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Right, so now I want to ask you some questions about how you travelled here today. Did you use public transport?

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: Yes. I came by bus.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: OK. And that was today. It’s the 24th of April, isn’t it? Q2

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: Isn’t it the 25th? No, actually, you’re right.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Ha ha. And what was the reason for your trip today? I can see you’ve got some shopping with you.

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: Yes. I did some shopping but the main reason I came here was to go to the dentist. Q3

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: That’s not much fun. Hope it was nothing serious.

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: No, it was just a check-up. It’s fine.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Good. Do you normally travel by bus into the city centre?

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: Yes. I stopped driving in ages ago because parking was so difficult to find and it costs so much. Q4

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: I see.

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: The bus is much more convenient too. It only takes about 30 minutes.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: That’s good. So where did you start your journey?

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: At the bus stop on Claxby Street. Q5

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Is that C-L-A-X-B-Y?

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: That’s right.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: And how satisfied with the service are you? Do you have any complaints?

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: Well, as I said, it’s very convenient and quick when it’s on time, but this morning it was late. Only about 10 minutes, but still. Q6

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Yes, I understand that’s annoying. And what about the timetable? Do you have any comments about that?

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: Mmm. I suppose I mainly use the bus during the day, but any time I’ve been in town in the evening – for dinner or at the cinema – I’ve noticed you have to wait a long time for a bus – there aren’t that many. Q7

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: OK, thanks. So now I’d like to ask you about your car use.

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: Well, I have got a car but I don’t use it that often. Mainly just to go to the supermarket. But that’s about it really. My husband uses it at the weekends to go to the golf club. Q8

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: And what about a bicycle?

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: I don’t actually have one at the moment.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: What about the city bikes you can rent? Do you ever use those?

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: No – I’m not keen on cycling there because of all the pollution. But I would like to get a bike – it would be good to use it to get to work. Q9

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: So why haven’t you got one now?

cues.speaker: SADIE
cues.text: Well, I live in a flat – on the second floor and it doesn’t have any storage – so we’d have to leave it in the hall outside the flat. Q10

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: I see. OK. Well, I think that’s all …
